findings.title: Unpinned package executed on every start: @salesforce/pwa-kit-mcp
findings.detail: 'salesforce__pwa-kit-mcp' launches @salesforce/pwa-kit-mcp through npx without a version. The client resolves the version at start time, so any future publish to that package name runs with your credentials. This is how postmark-mcp (Sept 2025) reached roughly 300 organisations.
findings.remediation: Pin an exact version and an integrity hash: "args": ["@salesforce/pwa-kit-mcp@<version>"] and drop the -y flag. Re-pin deliberately, after reviewing the diff.

findings.title: No baseline supplied - drift detection is disabled
findings.detail: Without an approved snapshot the scanner cannot tell a tool that has always been there from one that appeared yesterday. The single most effective MCP control is the diff, and it needs a baseline to diff against.
findings.remediation: Run 'mcp-scrutiny baseline --config <file> --out mcp-baseline.json', commit the file, and pass it back with --baseline on every later scan.
